title: Speed Aura
wikitext:
{{for|the player skill|Haste}} {{Status |name=Speed Aura |icon=Haste skill icon.png |type=Buff |description=Allies Move and Attack Faster |bonuses=Nearby Allies have #% increased Attack and Cast Speed
#% increased Movement Speed }} '''Speed Aura''' is a [[monster aura]] that grants increased [[movement]], [[Cast speed|cast]] and [[attack speed]]. Player can be affected by this aura by using a {{il|Headhunter}} or {{il|Inspired Learning}}, which can steal the [[Modifier:MonsterModSpeedAura|{{c|mod|of Haste}}]] [[Monster modifiers|monster modifier]] from rare monsters. Also, when converting a special [[Fickle Totem]][[Monster:Metadata/Monsters/Totems/SextantMapHasteAndCritChance]] to friendly from the removed [[sextant]] mod {{c|mod|Areas contain # additional packs of Monsters that Convert when Killed}}, or converting any non-unique monsters with this mod to friendlies temporarily by using {{il|Conversion Trap}} can allow player to benefit from the aura while nearby. The status icon of this buff uses the same icon as {{il|Haste}} and {{il|Vaal Haste}} skill gems. The buff (Archnemesis version) grants {{c|mod|Nearby Allies have 30% increased Attack and Cast Speed}} (despite the buff description only stating "{{c|normal|Attack Faster}}") and grants the aura caster itself {{c|mod|40% increased Movement Speed}}.{{cite web|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3267228|title=What's Next for Archnemesis Modifiers |author=Chris|date=May 15, 2022|accessdate=June 18, 2023|publisher=Official Path of Exile Forums}} However, the values may be changed after the version 3.20.0 monster mod re-rework, or not related to unique monster / totem versions. ==Sources== * Randomly appears on rare monsters * [[Totems]] ([[Modifier:MonsterTotemAuraSpeed1 ~~ ~~|MonsterTotemAuraSpeed1]], [[Modifier:MonsterImplicitAuraSpeedSextant~|MonsterImplicitAuraSpeedSextant]]) * Some unique monsters ([[Modifier:MonsterImplicitAuraSpeed1|MonsterImplicitAuraSpeed1]]) or the [[Modifier:MonsterModSpeedAura|{{c|mod|of Haste}}]] monster mod (displayed as "{{c|normal|Haste Aura}} in the monster nameplate) ** [[Kali the Crazed]] ** [[The Hollow Lady]] ** [[Hatespitter]] ** [[Spirit of Aidan]] ** [[Aidan the Frenzied]] ** [[Blood Morpher]] ** [[Jik'shah]] ([[Modifier:MonsterAuraSpeedUniqueMap1|MonsterAuraSpeedUniqueMap1]]) ==Mods== The aura radius of each mod is different. The table below displays the radius as [[unit]] which is 0.1 in-game metre. {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = domain = "3" AND (mods.mod_type="MonsterAuraSpeed" AND mods.id NOT IN ( "StrIntMissionAuraSpeed1", "MonsterAuraSpeed1") OR mods.id = "MonsterModSpeedAura" ) |stat_text=1 |level=1 |buff=1 |spawn_weights=1 }} ===Legacy mods=== {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = (domain = "3" AND mods.mod_type="MonsterAuraSpeed" AND mods.id NOT LIKE "%Implicit%" AND mods.id NOT LIKE "%Totem%" AND mods.id NOT LIKE "%Unique%" ) OR mods.id = "MonsterArchnemesisRaider_" |stat_text=1 |level=1 |buff=1 |spawn_weights=1 }} Note that [[Archnemesis]] mod {{ml|MonsterArchnemesisRaiderMagic}} which only appears on magic rarity monsters does not include Speed Aura. It is not the same mod as the double legacy {{ml|MonsterFastRun1}} mod, or the [[Sentinel]]'s {{ml|SentinelCastSpeed3}} mod. ==Gallery== File:Speed Aura skill screenshot.jpg|Official game beta screenshothttps://web.archive.org/web/20120608140904/http://www.pathofexile.com/monsterauras File:Jik'shah monster screenshot.jpg|[[Jik'shah]] File:Kali the Crazed.png|[[Kali the Crazed]] File:Aidan the Frenzied.png|[[Aidan the Frenzied]] File:Speed Aura.png|Visual of a player character with stolen Hasted Archnemesis mod ('''Speed Aura''') File:Speed and Accuracy and Crits Auras HH.png|Visual of a player character with stolen Archnemesis monster mods, including Deadeye ([[Accuracy and Crits Aura]]), Hasted ('''Speed Aura''') and Bloodletter File:Death Bishop with Hasted mod.png|Magic monster ([[Death Bishop]]) with {{c|mod|Swift}} (Hasted) Archnemesis mod, which does not include Speed Aura. It has different visual effect instead. ==Version history== Initially, it could appear on any monster as the non-unique non-implicit version granted from the mod [[Modifier:MonsterAuraSpeed1|{{c|mod|Speed Aura}}]] (displayed under the monster nameplate as {{c|normal|Allies Move and Attack Faster}}). This was replaced by [[Archnemesis modifier|Archnemesis monster mod]] {{ml|MonsterArchnemesisRaider_}} ({{ml|MonsterArchnemesisRaiderMagic}} the magic version does not have monster aura), which was displayed under the monster nameplate as Hasted. However, Archnemesis modifiers were replaced in version 3.20.0 with a new set of monster modifiers due to negative feedback. The current {{ml|MonsterModAttackCastMovementSpeed}} (displayed as "{{c|normal|Hasted}}" in the monster nameplate) mod does not grant this aura to the monster. It grants the equivalent stat to the monster only but not its allies. The mod that grants the aura is [[Modifier:MonsterModSpeedAura|{{c|mod|of Haste}}]] (displayed as "{{c|normal|Haste Aura}}" in the monster nameplate). The initial version can still be found in captured beasts in [[The Menagerie]], or [[Imprinted Bestiary Orb|itemized beasts]], in the [[permanent league]]s and can be stolen by {{il|Headhunter}} and {{il|Inspired Learning}}. {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.20.0| * Monster mods now only do one specific thing. }} {{Version history table row|3.18.0c| * The "Hasted" archnemesis monster modifier will now be first encountered on level 6 monsters. }} {{Version history table row|3.18.0| * Archnemesis modifiers have been rebalanced and added to the core game. Existing Magic and Rare monster modifiers have been replaced with Archnemesis modifiers. }} {{Version history table row|0.10.0|rel=before| * Introduced to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==See also== * {{stl|Speed Gale}} [[Category:Monster auras]]
